question: Are the fixed-graph amplitude-limit states nu_n of R-509 Cauchy on every fixed finite-support bounded continuous gauge-invariant amplitude cylinder under the same neutral coordinate restrictions as n tends to infinity?
classification_if_success: AUXILIARY_SUPPORT: one common local-state input, not closure of the active T-054 evidence-role gate or of a generator limit.

scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 on the PAH-OMC-004 anchored two-cell strip G_n, n>=2, at the PAH-OMC-016 fixed parameters.
scope.state: nu_n is exactly the R-509 j-limit with density exp(-F_n)/Z_n relative to product dr_v times labelled counting measure on aperture, phase and link bits. Phases at r=0 are retained; no gauge quotient, probe, radial Jacobian or sector fitting.
scope.order: First j->infinity at each fixed n on R_max=2^j, M_psi=2^(2j), then n->infinity. K=2, M_s=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1 and every source coupling remain fixed. No joint limit or limit interchange.
scope.geometry: Two vertices per column; split triangular cells i<n and the original unsplit frontier square i=n. O={(0,0)} and C={(0,1)} remain labels, not field boundary values.
scope.volume: |V_n|=2(n+2); n is an anchored relational exhaustion, not physical volume or dimension.
scope.normalization: Original labelled Gibbs normalization; additive finite parts fixed by the source. Positive transfer normalization is an algebraic ratio identity only.
scope.dynamics: Original rates and external Markov time are unchanged but no temporal generator or dynamics limit is evaluated by this contract.

common_observable_algebra.prefix_Lambda_m: For integer m>=0 retain vertices and vertical edges in columns 0,...,m and horizontal/diagonal links in cells 0,...,m-1. Every retained cell is split in all G_n with n>=max(2,m).
common_observable_algebra.A_m: Real bounded continuous functions of the retained amplitudes and finite labels, invariant under the induced local Z_2 gauge action and anchor-preserving automorphisms. Discrete labels carry the discrete topology. Complex observables are obtained by linear extension, not a new measure.
common_observable_algebra.embeddings: I_(m,m+1)f=f composed with coordinate forgetting. Retain exact amplitudes and old labels; no Gibbs conditional expectation, interpolation, grade selection or rate modification.
common_observable_algebra.all_local_coverage: Every finite set of vertices/edges of the infinite half-strip lies in some Lambda_m. An observable originally involving the unsplit terminal square of G_k is a function of its boundary links in Lambda_(k+1), ignoring the added diagonal; no equality of finite Gibbs laws is assumed.
common_observable_algebra.support_stage: N_support(f)=max(2,m(f)), where m(f) is the smallest prefix containing every vertex/edge coordinate used by f. This is a support definition, not a convergence assertion.
common_observable_algebra.norm: ||f||_infinity on its fixed prefix. No raw integer occupation cylinder is substituted for an amplitude cylinder.

exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.role: A regrouping of the existing Gibbs integral, not a new carrier, Hamiltonian, physical projection, conditional state selection or time evolution.
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.column: x=(r_0,r_1,s_0,s_1,k_0,k_1,v) with r>=0, aperture bits s in {1/2,1}, phase bits k in Z_2 and vertical link bit v in Z_2; measure xi=dr_0 dr_1 times labelled counting. H=L2(X,xi).
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.W: The two original onsite energies plus the original vertical-edge aperture and covariant-matter energies, each with its original coefficient.
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.B_triangle: For adjacent columns x,y and cross-link bits eta=(h0,h1,d), sum the original two horizontal-edge energies, the original bottom-left to top-right diagonal-edge energy, and the two original triangular Wilson energies. Every J_p is its own boundary average including the appropriate vertical edge.
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.B_square: For adjacent columns x,y and theta=(h0,h1), sum the original two horizontal-edge energies and the original unsplit square Wilson energy. There is no diagonal in this terminal cell.
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.K: K(x,y)=sum_(eta in Z_2^3) k_eta(x,y), (Kh)(x)=integral K(x,y)h(y) dxi(y)
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.S: S(x,y)=u(x) sum_(theta in Z_2^2) exp(-B_square(x,y;theta)) u(y)
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.boundary: g=Su; target exact identity Z_n=<u,K^n g>. The unsplit square stays in g; the endpoint half-onsite factors stay in u.
exact_spatial_transfer_proposal.insertion: For real f in A_m, integrate u(x_0) f times product_(i<m) k_(eta_i)(x_i,x_(i+1)) over earlier columns and sum cross-link bits, leaving x_m free; call this w_f. Target identities w_1=(K*)^m u and nu_n(f)=<w_f,K^(n-m)g>/<w_1,K^(n-m)g>.
not_assumed: the L2 positive cone has nonempty interior
a uniform lower bound K(x,y)>=c u(x)u(y) on unbounded amplitudes
a numeric spectral gap from finite matrices
any equality of old and new finite Gibbs marginals

proof_plan_and_budget.budget: One bounded contract/proof attempt under DCTRL-000008; intermediate checks are accumulated into one gate-level synthesis.
steps: Verify source pins and the term-by-term transfer factorization, edge directions, multiplicities and endpoint normalization.
Prove Hilbert-Schmidt compactness and positivity improving on the stated unbounded L2 space; prove positive spectral radius by a fixed compact test box, not a change of the Gibbs domain.

Audit a weak Krein-Rutman import for the total L2 cone; prove simplicity, absence of peripheral competitors and the normalized power bound without assuming self-adjointness or using a solid-cone theorem.
Control numerator and positive denominator for each frozen prefix to obtain an explicit Cauchy bound in the declared order.
Run primary and non-importing independent algebra/normalization checks, hostile mutation checks and a limited Lean bridge; record what those executions do not formalize.
proof_plan_and_budget.quantitative_convention: A theorem with exact operator-defined constants q in (0,1) and C_q finite counts as analytic Cauchy control if their existence is proved for this K and a formula for the prefix error and N(epsilon,f) is given. This is not a certified numerical value of the spectral gap or a computable interval enclosure; no sampled eigenvalue is evidence for the infinite-dimensional gap.
proof_plan_and_budget.review_after: Re-review after this one attempt, an exact counterexample, any source/observable/limit drift, or a missing imported-theorem hypothesis. No replacement kernel or subsequence may be introduced to rescue it.

outcomes.PASS: Exact local Cauchy proof on every frozen prefix, applicable analytic inputs, independent and hostile verification and bounded Lean disposition.
outcomes.NEGATIVE_RESULT: An exact non-Cauchy witness for the frozen state/observable sequence; failure of a proposed proof method alone is not such a witness.
outcomes.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: A named analytic or map hypothesis remains open; state exactly the single next evidence question.

non_claims: No resolution of PAH-OMC-014, no common generator domain, no infinite-volume dynamics or stationary dynamics construction.
No full local-cutoff removal, lattice/continuum, arbitrary exhaustion or boundary-condition uniformity, phase/beta limit or thermodynamic uniqueness across all Gibbs boundary states.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, common causal cone, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, mass gap, observation prediction or TOE conclusion.
No Q3LOCK result is imported; R-509 is only the fixed-graph amplitude-state input and previously proved uniform bounds.
T-054 active gate and every claim tier remain unchanged by registration or auxiliary success.
